subject: How to get the currently selected tab in a gadget using miniTabstripPanel?

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: How to get the currently selected tab in a gadget using miniTabstripPanel?
parts:
For some reason I can't seem to figure out how to get the value of the selected tab in a shiny gadget.  I thought it'd be straight forward, but this isn't working.  Not sure if there's a bug, or if I'm missing something.

Example: nothing ever gets printed in this gadget

library(shiny)
library(miniUI)

ui <- miniPage(
  miniTabstripPanel(
    id = "mytabs",
    miniTabPanel("Tab 1", value = "tab1", "tab 1"),
    miniTabPanel("Tab 2", value = "tab2", "tab 2"),
    miniTabPanel("Tab 3", value = "tab3", "tab 3")
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  observe({
    cat(input$mytabs)
  })
}

runGadget(ui, server)
